name: ScriptaHub – Edit edition
description: Apply the reserved changes to one existing book edition, validate and publish the exact package.

tasks.name: Read the approved edition requests
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

Read the matching claimed.json and durable handoff supplied by edit-book. Confirm this execution and the service status. Set processingMode using the shared contract and pass it through the single outgoing edge.

In process mode, retain the complete task.requests snapshot, request/annotation IDs, languages, file indexes, base revisions and configured repositories in <taskDirectory>/run-state/edit.json. Preserve the original approved snapshot across retries. Save its path with step=claim-edit.

tasks.name: Moderate request and source materials
tasks.prompt: Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and its Content moderation section. In process mode classify every submission review unit with your current RoboTeam model using moderate-content. Proceed only on the service's final passed status. Report the actual reason if the task stops or the selected model cannot inspect required images.

tasks.name: Apply the approved changes
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

In process mode, locate the book by ID in its existing configured catalogue. Call handoff with step=apply-edit and the chosen configured URL as catalogue. Use the returned pinned branch, base commit and schemaVersion for all book resources and the package. On retry reuse the pinned baseline and each saved reader whose evidence still matches. Fetch only its metadata, required book resources and immutable baseline readers using those pinned references. Use verified download for request attachments with the service's global indexes.

Apply the complete approved request set to one new edition. Resolve each annotation in the specified language and revision using its exact quote, prefix/suffix and reader textContent offsets. Identify annotations by request ID and annotation ID. Apply general revision instructions only where the request authorizes them. Conflicting, stale or ambiguous passages block the edition with a concrete finding.

Apply the full Content moderation policy to every sensitive subject in new or rewritten prose. Keep romantic passages non-graphic, using emotion, dialogue and gestures and fading to black before sexual activity. Use restrained language and non-graphic visuals for sensitive subjects. Check revised passages and artwork before saving the candidate. If the requested change itself requires prohibited material, stop with the moderation reason for the requester.

Keep attribution, existing languages/formats, other book entries, images and previous edition history. Keep unaffected resources and translations as they are; a targeted correction does not request new translations or a separate editorial rewrite. Save step=apply-edit with the changed reader paths. The helper preserves the pinned destination. In edit.json record one entry for each affected language with language, baselineHtml, baselineSha256, candidateHtml and changesPath plus changesSha256. Each change record is {annotationId,before,after,prefix,suffix}; use an empty list for presentation-only changes. Retain the approved request/annotation pair alongside the implemented changes.

Review each finalized edited reader HTML with the artifact moderation procedure.

tasks.name: Prepare the edition publication package
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

In process mode, assemble a sparse package at <taskDirectory>/package for the pinned destination. Append the new edition in the existing schema, preserve historical resource aliases and old bytes, and update the current book metadata and catalogue entry. Carry existing covers and other referenced resources when needed. Apply the shared package preparation and schema 1 keyword index procedure.

Move or copy each affected canonical reader into its final publication path and record that candidateHtml in edit.json. Keep the immutable baselines and changes files private. Freeze the package and verify its draft inventory. Save step=prepare-edit-package with the package and inventory paths. Report any concrete package failure.

tasks.name: Validate the edition publication package
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

In process mode, independently audit the exact staged candidate of every language in edit.json. Run native compare-edition BASELINE --candidate CANDIDATE --changes CHANGES --job-dir <taskDirectory>/validation/edit-layout-LANGUAGE. Use the immutable baseline and authorized change report for that language. Report existing layout findings as warnings and block new regressions or missing evidence.

Verify all approved changes are accounted for and the change plan still matches the pinned originals. Call verify-package with finalize=true, editionPlan=edit.json and audits=[{language,report}] for every affected language. Upload the approved inventory with stage-publication and complete the remaining package moderation units. Save the approval paths with step=validate-edit and run complete-phase. The validation stage leaves package bytes untouched.

tasks.name: Publish the validated edition
tasks.prompt:
Follow scriptahub-tasks SKILL.md and the operation reference for execution context, native calls, recovery, handoff, source scope and acceptance.

In process mode call retry-publication for the staged and moderated package from validate-edit. Confirm the actual service status. Keep the execution identity and exact validated bytes on any retry. Save the actual publication response and receipt paths with step=submit-edit. The parent reconciles this item independently.

defaultObjective: Process exactly one reserved edition request in the parent working directory.
